description: Agent Legal: submit the exhibits and schedules an agreement references with the exhibits actually attached: the references with the agreement and each exhibit, schedule, annex or appendix with its label, the title, the version and the date the agreement cites for it; the attached set with each exhibit’s label, title, version and date as attached. The signed report gives the references and the attached set, each referenced exhibit paired with its attached copies, every referenced exhibit missing and every attached exhibit the agreement never references named, and the version and date of each attached exhibit against the ones the agreement cites, and counts them, and names a discrepant set: a referenced exhibit that is missing, an attached exhibit the agreement never references and a version or date unlike the one the agreement cites; then an attached exhibit under another title and an exhibit attached twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A version or date the agreement cites that the attached exhibit does not carry, or no references and no attachments, leaves the set unverified. Exhibits read by their kind and identifier, so Exhibit A, Ex. A and EXHIBIT A are one exhibit and Schedule 2 and Sch. 2 one schedule, versions without their Version, v or Rev prefix or trailing zeros, dates as days and titles by their words with plurals folded. Verdict legal_exhibit_discrepant, legal_exhibit_partial, legal_exhibit_unverified or legal_exhibit_consistent. POST /api/legal-exhibit-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.
